blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Westridge. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Westridge, Burnaby: 10 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 21 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Westridge was little changed, 10 in June and 10 in September (+0.0%), and 3 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.2% of Burnaby’s 458 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Westridge?
Westridge also had 5 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in September, against 10 houses listed.
Westridge home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

9 houses sold in Westridge with a median price of $1,840,000 (the middle half sold between $1,587,000 and $2,980,000), taking a median of 51 days to sell at 92.7% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $706 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median lot of 7,208 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Westridge?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses listed in Westridge. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Westridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Westridge had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Westridge from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in Westridge over those 4 months, out of 199 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Westridge?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Westridge sell for?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Westridge between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,840,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Westridge?
faq.a: The median was 51 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 92.7% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
